about: Hand-maintained corrections and additions to offers/custofinal.json (the scraped blog). An entry whose id exists there overrides the fields it lists; {"id": ..., "disable": true} removes it; {"add": true} adds a new offer (all fields required); an override or disable whose id is not in the scrape fails the tests. Every entry needs source and checkedAt, and the source host must be in sourceHosts (also for offers/nap-notes.json). Guide: docs/04-operator-offers.md.

offers.label: Telpark - App Telpark (lançamento, -15 %)
offers.why: Launch of Telpark's app charging in its Portuguese car parks: 15 % off every charge started from the app (the promo page), until 31 Dec 2026 (the app's announcement; the page gives no end date). Prices from the Telpark app (screenshots, 10 Nov 2026), the same at every site seen: 22 kW AC 0.59 (0.69 crossed out) at Luíz I, Campo de Ourique and Praça do Rossio; DC 0.64 (0.75) at 30 kW (Luíz I) and 60 kW (Praça do Rossio, Aveiro), 0.67 (0.79) at 120 kW (Campo de Ourique) and 172 kW (Maria Cristina). Not seen: the 100 kW sockets (the 60 kW price is assumed for the whole band) and the 150 kW band (no Telpark socket there in the NAP; between two equal prices). Telpark has nothing above 180 kW, so dcMax is left out. telpark-app-telpark takes over on 1 Jan.

offers.label: Telpark - App Telpark
offers.why: Telpark's app price without the launch discount (the crossed-out prices in the app at Luíz I, Campo de Ourique, Praça do Rossio and Maria Cristina, 10 Nov 2026). Re-check it in January: it's what the app showed before the discount, not a published list.

offers.label: Atlante - App MyAtlante Business
offers.why: myAtlante Business's single price on fast and ultra-fast chargers, on Atlante's own network; on AC it uses its CEME tariff (ceme-v2). Only shown to drivers who hold it.

offers.label: Atlante - App MyAtlante Business
offers.why: myAtlante Business's single price on fast and ultra-fast chargers, on other operators' chargers; on AC it uses its CEME tariff (ceme-v2). Only shown to drivers who hold it.

On DC the myAtlante app charges this flat price instead of its CEME tariff (energy + operator fee). myAtlante Business has its own DC price (atlante-app-myatlante-business-*). ChargeBack without Atlante Go: 25 GreenGems per euro paid at Atlante chargers (100 GreenGems = 1 euro of credit, spent automatically on the next charges at Atlante stations), campaign 1 Oct to 31 Dec (https://atlante.energy/pt-pt/myatlante-app/, 24 Nov 2026); 10 % outside Atlante's network is half of Atlante Go's 20 %, which is what Atlante's 27-30 Nov campaign (https://www.facebook.com/reel/1836246847518324) doubles to 50 % + 20 %. Nothing published says the ChargeBack covers AC sessions on the CEME tariff, so it's only on this DC price.

offers.label: Atlante - Atlante Go
offers.why: Atlante Go is 7,99 €/month, cancel any time, with 50 % ChargeBack on Atlante's network and 20 % outside it, 1 Oct to 31 Dec (https://atlante.energy/pt-pt/atlante-go/, 24 Nov 2026; the blog's label says 8 €). Atlante's 27-30 Nov 2026 campaign (the reel, and its poster: 'Atlante Go por 5,99€/mês válido apenas para novas adesões. Este valor é garantido enquanto a subscrição estiver ativa. Campanha válida de 27 a 30 de novembro 2026.') doubles the ChargeBack to 100 % + 40 % and lowers the fee for new sign-ups. atlante.energy didn't carry the campaign yet on 24 Nov: re-check it there. The 0,49 €/kWh is the blog's and Atlante's tariff page's.

IONITY App (no subscription) on IONITY's price page with Portugal selected, 23 Nov 2026: from 0.59 €/kWh, VAT in. The blog's 22 Nov post says 0.62. IONITY gives its current minimum: a station may charge more.

IONITY Direct (card at the charger or QR, no app) on IONITY's price page with Portugal selected, 23 Nov 2026: from 0.63 €/kWh, VAT in. The blog's 22 Nov post says 0.66. IONITY gives its current minimum: a station may charge more.

offers.label: Electroverse - colaboradores Powerdot (50 %)
offers.why: Powerdot employees pay half of Electroverse's price at Powerdot chargers. Only the 150 kW band was seen (0.36 €/kWh + 0.30 € connection fee, exactly half of Electroverse's MOBI.E-wide 0.72, now electroverse-outros-mobi-e); the other bands are half of that row too, not seen. The employee discount itself has no public page: the 150 kW price is from a Powerdot employee's Electroverse app at HRZ-AMD-00054 (screenshot, 30 Oct 2026); the source is the blog row it halves.

Electroverse's map, 23 Nov 2026, at 8 Atlante sites, no time price and no connection fee at any: 0.60 €/kWh at AC 7 and 22 kW and DC 50-60 kW (PRT-00221/00225, LSB-00662, LSB-80044, GMR-70012, STB-00122; some from screenshots), 0.70 at DC 100 kW (TVD-00041), 150 kW (PBL-00018) and 300 kW (TNV-00031..00034). The blog's notice marks AC 22 as kWh + minutes (not seen anywhere, so perMinute is emptied) and has 0.75 above 180 kW (0.70 seen). Our dc100 band (51-100 kW) holds 228 Atlante sockets at 60 kW (0.60) and 76 at 100 kW (0.70): it gets 0.60, so a 100 kW Atlante socket shows 0.10 €/kWh too low.

The blog's notice (22 Nov 2026) marks Galp AC 22 and 43 as kWh + minutes without the rates. Electroverse's public map, 23 Nov 2026: AC 22 kW 0.42 €/kWh + 0.05 €/min at all 19 GLPP sites seen (ALB-00022, ALM-00106, ALM-90010, AMD-00068, AVR-00093, BRG-00159, BTL-90001, GMR-00172, GMR-90001, LGS-00018, LRA-00139, LRA-00143, LSB-00519, MRV-90001, OBR-00014, OBR-00015, PMS-90001, SSB-00009, SXL-00071), whatever Galp's own MOBI.E time fee there (0.0375, 0.039 or 0.125 €/min); PRT-00314 the same in the app (screenshot). AC 43 kW 0.60 €/kWh + 0.08 €/min at 6 sites (ALQ-00005, CTB-00056, OER-00069, OER-00076, SXL-00073, TVR-00027). AC 7 and 11 kW and DC have no time price, as in the notice. A 0.30 € connection fee per session everywhere. Scope GLPP only: at the two GLPG sites seen (GLG-LSB-00310, GLG-SNS-00006) AC 22 is 0.42 without minutes and DC 50 0.60, the MOBI.E-wide row's prices, so those get electroverse-outros-mobi-e.

Electroverse's public map, 23 Nov 2026: a 0.30 € connection fee per session at every charger seen, AC and DC: EDP (LOU-00008, PLM-00072), Powerdot (ODV-00028, BRG-00115), Prio (PSR-00017), MOBI.E (BRG-00006), Galp and EMEL. The blog's rows leave it out. The per-kWh prices there match the blog's notice row (0.42 at 22 kW, 0.72 at 60-120 kW, 0.79 at 180-200 kW).

Electroverse's map, 23 Nov 2026. AC 22 kW at EML-LSB-00418 (Largo da República da Turquia, sockets LSB-00418..00420, screenshot): 0.60 €/kWh + 0.25 €/min, not the 0.42 the notice gives EMEL's 11 kW; the notice only says 22 kW bills per minute. One site seen for AC 22. A 0.30 € connection fee per session at every EMEL socket seen: that one, LSB-00393/00395 (Campo Grande: DC 50 kW and AC 43 kW 0.60 €/kWh, screenshot) and LSB-00352..00363 (DC 50 kW, AC 43 kW 0.60 €/kWh, no time price).

Tesla prices every Supercharger on its own and by time of day (Mealhada in the Tesla app, 29 Oct 2026: 0.27 / 0.41 / 0.58 €/kWh without subscription); the blog's one price for the whole network is wrong at most sites and hours. The NAP's per-site price (offers/nap-notes.json) stands in.
